author: Nathan Sweet
evidential_status: Prospective research proposals. No study-specific preregistration, recruitment, data collection, ethics approval, power analysis, or empirical confirmation is claimed. Freeze before each decisive dataset.
protocol_concept: Joint closure/self-world-action history fingerprint; evaluate comparative increment and separately test phenomenal bridge, never infer it from functional outcomes

authorization.scope: Authoring public hypotheses and a pre-data protocol proposal, not authorizing interventions on participants

globally_prespecified.label_rule: Candidate C cannot define Y; record label source, blinding, calibration, dependencies, uncertain/no-report cases.
globally_prespecified.scoring: On held-out interventions, Delta=Loss(best frozen rival,Y)-Loss(best rival plus closure-specific C,Y). Positive Delta supports only incremental prediction on Y. Predefine rival selection, information budget, score, complexity adjustment, alpha/multiplicity or uncertainty interval, and minimum meaningful improvement before data.
globally_prespecified.model_lock: Archive implementations, versions, parameter counts, computational resource budgets, and adversarial forecasts before unblinding.
globally_prespecified.outputs: Share all failures, adverse results, missing data, bridge failures, calibration checks, code, negative controls and revised claims; never count correlated measures as independent replications.
prerequisites_for_actual_registration: named participating site/investigators and authorized system
primary and secondary outcomes with units
construct and label provenance plus measurement error
analysis code, test/train separation, loss margin
missing data, deviations, multiplicity and stopping rule
timestamped public/registry record before decisive data
